buildings:1000106.name: Squad Barracks
buildings:1000106.source: NotAmti/Clash-of-Clans-Datamine report 2026-11-16 (fingerprint 0f8af5ebc59d) plus export of 18 Nov 2026, 22:59
buildings:1000106.note: Inferred: first seen being built (L0) in a Town Hall 11 export. Of the buildings added since v18.200.9 without an ID, Squad Barracks (TownHallLevel 8, BuildCost 1,700,000) is the only Home Village one a Town Hall 11 can build; Guardian Shrine, Spiky Tower and Firecracker Tower need Town Hall 19 and BB Builders Hut is on the Builder Base. Confirm in game. Levels: 12, one per Town Hall from 8 to 19 (Clash of Clans Wiki, Squad Barracks page, 18 Nov 2026).
